spec.response_law: Study A-G strong persistent law. Fixed bank-weighted aggregate equals the common process; bank deviations sum to zero. Each raw bank/date row has initial and eligible correction plus a future revision. Historical cutoff is date+1. Full generation/Parquet/reconstruction/aggregation/fitting/bands/weak-IV inversion/bandwidth comparison/reporting included.
spec.learning_law: Study A-L bounded sparse model; both blocked sparse and factor3 fits and covariance included after version filtering and Parquet roundtrip. Fixed penalty multiplier .1, factor rank3.
spec.latent_law: Study B-L strong binary model, three starts, 70 EM steps and 180 L-BFGS-B cap; observed-information interval and 19 whole-trajectory bootstrap refits. Bootstrap count measures cost only; it is inadequate for precise 95 percent quantiles.
spec.discovery_law: Stable VAR1 with diagonal independent Gaussian innovations; diagonal .4 and first subdiagonal .15; supplied no contemporaneous effects; coefficient box and interval response propagation.
spec.acceptance: Numerical equality to separate reconstruction/moment reference within 1e-9. Record statistical error, failures, solver stops, process wall time, peak RSS, logical/physical I/O and output hashes. Do not discard a failed process or infer bank throughput from these synthetic dimensions.
spec.pilot: Run the first case of each kind once before the final repeated fresh-process runs. Keep pilot outputs separate; any changed workload needs a new spec version.
